name: The Time Weavers
realm: Threads of code spin forward, backward, and out of the way.
lesson: A lambda is an unnamed function: [capture](params){ body }. Captures list outside variables: [k] copies, [&k] references, [&] everything by reference. Iterators generalize pointers into containers (begin() / end()). std::move turns a named object into an rvalue so its resources can be stolen instead of copied.

trial.prompt: Which part of a lambda lists captured variables?
